answer: Each identity's usable standing is released only after a sequential, non-transferable custody period, and the release rate is super-linear in how many identities an operator runs, so a fleet cannot mature faster than one identity at a time. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. The relic is the serial tenure, the quartz the custody window that must elapse, and the plume the standing released at the end of it; the relic is personal, the quartz is not skippable, and the plume cannot be inherited by a sibling.
